control.description-key: PBS Hub host app H-0 Clock in and clock out: GPS position against Studio Location - PBS radius, selfie in and out, reason when outside the radius.

property.name: Context
property.description-key: JSON {userEmail,userName,roles,permissions,config}. config: clockInStatus (Hadir - Tugas), hkTugas (180000), statusAbsence (blank), defaultRadiusM (100), weakAccuracyM (100), minReasonChars (10), selfieMaxPx (960), selfieMaxKb (350), maxShiftHours (12).

property.name: HostJson
property.description-key: JSON row of the signed-in host [Host - PBS Hub]: Title, NamaHost, Email. Never send KTP or bank data.

property.name: LocationsJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Studio Location - PBS]: Title, LocationID, Latitude, Longitude, RadiusMeter, IsActive.

property.name: ClockInJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Clock In - PBS Hub] for this host, last 2 days: ID, Title, HostID, ClockInDate, CheckInTime, CheckOutTime, CheckInOffice, Reason.

property.name: SchedulesJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Schedule - PBS Hub] for this host, yesterday and today: Title, Date, StartTime, EndTime, HostID, Status. Used for ScheduleCount.

property.name: ReportsJson
property.description-key: JSON rows of [Report - PBS Hub] for this host, yesterday and today: Title, ScheduleID, HostID, LiveDate. Used for TotalReports on clock out.

property.name: DeviceLocationJson
property.description-key: Optional JSON {Latitude, Longitude} from the canvas Location signal, used when the browser position is blocked.

property.name: IsLoading
property.description-key: true while canvas is loading: renders skeletons.

property.name: ReferenceDate
property.description-key: Optional ISO date-time used as now (testing).

property.name: ActionResult
property.description-key: Canvas reply {requestId,status,message} for CLOCK_IN and CLOCK_OUT.

property.name: UploadData
property.description-key: Base64 JPEG selfie (no data: prefix) that belongs to the CLOCK_IN or CLOCK_OUT in ActionPayload. Empty for other actions.
